design_notes: Serif throughout, hairline rules, two rule weights; single accent colour for the pull-quote rule and table header rule.
Financials table: right-align all numeric columns, keep the ₹ crore unit in the stub column, no zebra striping.
Peer comparison table: render the 'Status in the excerpts' column in italic to signal it is editorial annotation, not filing data.
Industry snapshot: stat strip as three equal columns above the growth bars; label the 2020 bar 'projected' in the accent colour.
No icons, no imagery, no charts beyond the specified bars.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: One name on that list is not like the others. Western Rail
pull_quotes.quote: It accounts for 52% of the orders on hand [^drhp-p65], and revenue from key customers for the year ended March 31, 2018 was 57% of total revenue [^drhp-p67].
pull_quotes.rationale: Customer concentration is the single disclosed fact that most changes how a reader weighs the whole filing.

sidebars.body_markdown: 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value each, at an issue price left as ₹[•] [^drhp-p29]. The excerpts do not state whether this is a fresh issue or an offer for sale, and name no selling shareholder. Objects: ₹1,130 lakhs (₹11.30 crore) for working capital, and general corporate purposes with the amount left blank [^drhp-p48]. Lead manager: Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; registrar: Bigshare Services Private Limited [^drhp-p31]. No independent appraisal and no monitoring agency for the proceeds [^drhp-p18].
sidebars.rationale: The offer mechanics are scattered across four pages; a compact block lets the reader hold the terms before the analysis.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
